speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Drug eruption (maculopapular rash) secondary to new medication for arthritis.

*(Note: While I have already made the diagnosis based on the classic presentation of a new rash coinciding with a new medication and the absence of other specific infectious symptoms, I will ask one final clarifying question to confirm the timing relative to the first dose of the arthritis medication, as this is the most critical data point for a drug allergy.)*

What specific medication did your new provider prescribe for your arthritis, and when was your very first dose taken?
